# StreakSphere App

> StreakSphere is a social media platform featuring a Global Activity Feed, real-time MoodMaps, AR Spatial Chat, and AI-verified activity points.

## App Architecture & Context
This website serves as the primary landing page and distribution hub for the StreakSphere mobile application.
